join.intro: For university students, international students and Japanese-language-school students. SNIE has created opportunities to meet and share experiences across universities and cultures.
join.pathsTitle: How would you like to participate?

paths.title: Japanese university students
paths.description: Meet people beyond your own university through city walks, sports and shared activities. Start with the activity stories and member clubs.

paths.title: International students
paths.description: Explore opportunities to meet Japanese university students through conversation and seasonal events. Read the records of exchanges with Japanese-language-school students.

paths.title: Partner organizations and schools
paths.description: Learn how SNIE has worked with schools and other student groups. Review past collaborations and find the contact information on SNIE’s source website.

join.destinationBody: SNIE’s former website introduces its activities and lists social account handles. Check SNIE’s latest announcements for upcoming events and participation details. Historical event information here is not an open invitation or a current application.

faqItems.question: What kinds of activities are there?
faqItems.answer: The source website introduces Tokyo Orienteering, SOP and the Christmas Party, alongside BBQs, cruises and overnight trips. The activities page includes photographs with source links.

faqItems.question: Are there exchanges with Japanese-language schools?
faqItems.answer: The former site describes visitor sessions and joint events with language schools. Public records from 2025 also document exchanges with JET Japanese Language School.

faqItems.question: How can I join a future event?
faqItems.answer: Check the contact information on SNIE’s source website for the latest guidance. Historical event records on this site are not current registration notices.

privacy.intro: This page describes only the data and photo behavior visible in the current static website. It does not claim a broader SNIE organizational policy.
privacy.emptyTitle: No forms, accounts, or file uploads
privacy.emptyBody: This website serves static pages and locally preserved photographs from the former public SNIE site. It does not provide user accounts, application forms, or direct file uploads.
privacy.contactBody: Each photograph links to its source page. To contact SNIE about an image or its content, consult the original contact information page. Do not post personal or sensitive information in public.

reviewItems: Cloudflare Pages serves the website pages.

leadership.title: A president’s perspective
leadership.note: Summarized from the former website’s anonymous president interview. It gives no name or term, so no current officeholder is identified.

items.question: How did they get involved?
items.answer: They first joined as SOP staff in September of their first university year.

items.question: A favorite experience?
items.answer: Summer camp offered time to share experiences with fellow students.

items.question: Joining later?
items.answer: The interview highlights how approachable SNIE felt for students joining partway through.

history.title: Our shared history
history.intro: Follow SNIE’s exchanges through its former websites and newsletters. Roles, organizations and participation methods on this page belong to the period in which each source was published.
history.heading: Read the former websites
history.body: This collection preserves 22 pages and two PDFs. Text remains in its original language, and the date a page was saved is distinct from an event date. The collection does not contain every historical revision.
